objective: Test whether teacher-supervised LoRA improves source-grounded atomic claim extraction and scope retention.

student.architecture: Dense Qwen3.5-4B conditional-generation model; vision and all original weights frozen

teacher.role: Larger candidate teacher; superior label quality is a hypothesis, not established by model size

data.split_selection: Deterministic filename-hash order; two documents per project; two intact substantive blocks per document
data.source_status: Project-note snapshots; their upstream references have not been independently verified
data.context: Full source metadata, document title and nearest section heading accompany every selected block; unresolved external references are not invented.

supervision.citation_checks: Both supplied passage and full source snapshot must contain every quote and condition verbatim
supervision.semantic_check: Separate same-teacher critique; rejects and uncertain cases quarantined
supervision.repeatability: Pinned checkpoints, snapshot hashes, exact prompt/request/response caches, deterministic splits and optimization seed
supervision.evidence_alignment: A unique whitespace-only match may restore original source characters; original fragment and restored text are both logged. Words, punctuation and numbers are never repaired.
supervision.repair: At most two candidate attempts per passage. Checker feedback may guide the second attempt. Rejected attempts and exact requests remain cached.
supervision.final_policy: Nine source-reviewed local-teacher training proposals; one source-reviewed critic rejection restored and three accepted proposals excluded. Validation/test references are separately authored by the interactive Codex agent before student document training or inference. No independent human gold.

optimization.loss: Assistant target tokens only; prompt masked; never truncate evidence

evaluation.test_labels: Never passed to optimizer or validation
evaluation.paired_decoding: Greedy base versus final adapter, identical native NuExtract3 prompt
evaluation.required_review: Inspect generated claims against source; quote overlap and teacher-forced loss do not measure semantic truth
evaluation.promotion: No automatic deployment or claim verification
evaluation.references: Agent-authored source-assertion references, not teacher self-audits or independently human-certified truth

resource_policy.teacher: Local Vulkan GPU under Dibs gpu+port-8400
resource_policy.student_training: Local BF16 under Dibs gpu with isolated official AMD ROCm runtime when device check succeeds; CPU execution remains supported under Dibs cpu
resource_policy.performance_claims: None; use dibs --measure for any future speed comparison

commands: dibs run gpu port-8400 --label 'Generate local claim-distillation supervision' --eta 90m -- <python> training/pilot.py label
dibs run gpu --label 'Train source-grounded NuExtract3 LoRA pilot' --eta 90m -- training/rocm-env/bin/python training/pilot.py train --device cuda
dibs run gpu --label 'Compare held-out base and LoRA extractions' --eta 90m -- training/rocm-env/bin/python training/pilot.py evaluate --device cuda

runtime.dependency_provenance: rocm-install-plan.json retains official URLs and archive hashes; existing CPU environment supplies Transformers 5.14.1
runtime.torch_native_triton_overrides: Disabled in base and adapter runs; use precompiled ATen HIP operators because the host has no C development sysroot

amendment: The initial local-teacher pass was ended after all training passages had proposals because dense validation output exceeded its cap. Rejected/truncated responses and the initial failed supervisor status remain archived. The four fixed test cases remain included; the first fixed validation passage has an agent-authored reference and the other three remain unannotated.
